$comment: Props with no fixture that put markup on screen no fixture produces, classified from the AST by scripts/audit-fixture-gap.mjs. A ratchet: the count may fall, and a rise fails the gate. Re-record with `node scripts/audit-fixture-gap.mjs --record`.
$why: AvatarBadge's `variant` was in this set and carried a 3.76:1 colour pair that no gate could measure, because measuring needs a render. The number is what turns 'some of the API is unrendered' into something that can be watched.
limits: One hop of dataflow: a prop is followed into the variable a reference initialises, and that variable's references. A prop threaded through two variables, or through an object a `useMemo` returns, is not followed.

94 props land in `logic-only` and 115 in `passes-through`; both buckets can contain props that do reach markup by a route this does not follow. `passes-through` means 'handed to a child component' and does not decide whether the child's markup changes.
So the recorded count is a FLOOR, not a total. The error is toward under-reporting.
Identifier matching is by name within the component's own directory, so a local variable that shares a prop's name in another function in that directory can be read as a reference to it.

Prop coverage is read from each fixture's `props` object, so a fixture that must use `render` cannot register one. `AvatarGroup.renderSurplus` is the case: `Avatar/group-render-surplus` renders that exact branch and photographs it, and the audit still counts the prop as unfixtured because the group needs children and so cannot be expressed as a props bag. The 2026-09-12 rise from 17 to 18 is that, plus the wiring of `AvatarGroup.classes.surplus` — a slot that was in the public type and read nowhere, so a consumer could set it and it painted nothing.

2026-09-13: `Drawer.swipeable` was in that bucket for one day for the same reason and has left it. `Drawer/swipeable-bottom` renders the swipeable panel and photographs its grab handle, but it must use `render` to supply the Toggle and children, so its `props` bag is empty and this audit could not see the prop at all. The fix was a second fixture, `Drawer/open-swipeable`, that expresses the same prop as a props bag — which is also what `fixtures.contract` needs, since it instantiates from `props` and had failed on the unreachable `handle` classes key. One fixture for the photograph, one for the two audits that read `props`. That is the 151 → 150 fall.

2026-10-10, A2c (concept names and icon props): 150 → 148. The −2 is AccordionContent's `forceMount` and `unmountOnClose`, merged into one `keepMounted: boolean | "visited"` that has fixtures — the whole of "the component itself" 45 → 43. Renames carry their rank with them (`loadingText` → `loadingContent` ×4, `noResultsContent` → `emptyContent` ×5, `preventOutsideClick` → `closeOnOverlayClick`). Two icon props changed rank because their type changed, not because markup was added: Stepper `completedIcon` and `errorIcon` were ComponentTypes the component instantiated and are now ReactNodes rendered as given, so they read as a slot the fixtures never fill — slot 49 → 51, none-of-the-above 38 → 36. Props with no fixture fell 638 → 621, −17: twelve icon props filled by the A2c `*-custom-*-icon` fixtures (Dropdown chevron/clear, SearchableDropdown chevron/clear/search, MultiSelectDropdown chevron/clear, MultiSelectSearchableDropdown clear, CascadingDropdown clear/search, Breadcrumb ellipsis/separator — at HEAD these were renders-content, passes-through or logic-only, so outside `rendersMarkup`), three merged into `keepMounted` (the two above and TabPanel `forceMount`), and Dropdown and SearchableDropdown `CheckIcon`, folded into `selectedIcon`. Those fixtures are held to the default icon's box by e2e/icon-slots.spec.ts.

2026-10-11, A2e (routing; Breadcrumb `separatorIcon` folded into `separator`): 148 → 147. Breadcrumb's `separator` was unfixtured markup (none-of-the-above 36 → 35); the `custom-separator-icon` fixture that drew `separatorIcon` now passes the same glyph through `separator`, so it has a fixture and `separatorIcon` is gone. Props with no fixture rose 621 → 631, +10, none of them markup: `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby` newly declared on the five dropdowns (+10, renders-content), and Slider's newly declared `aria-describedby` (+1, passes-through), less Slider's `id`, which now names the thumb rather than passing through to the root (−1, attribute-only).
$basisChanges: 2026-10-11, A2f (routing): hand-edited, not re-recorded. propsWithoutFixture 631 → 639, rendersMarkup holds at 147. +13 newly declared attribute props with no fixture, none rendering markup: InternationalPhoneInput `numberAriaLabel`; Modal `style` and `id`; Stepper `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby`; TabPanel `aria-describedby`; Toast `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby`; Tooltip `id`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby`. −5: OtpInput `groupAriaLabel` (folded into `aria-label`), and InputLabel's and TextAreaLabel's `htmlFor` and `className`, now inherited from the label element's attributes rather than declared by the shared label helper. One rank move with no new markup: Tooltip `truncate`, whose un-overflowed branch now carries the consumer's `id` and `aria-*` on its span like the trigger wrapper does, reads as an ARIA attribute (markup with none of the above 35 → 34, an ARIA attribute 0 → 1).

2026-10-12, L13 (Pagination dropdownIcon rotates): rank move only, rendersMarkup held at 147. `Pagination.dropdownIcon` went from "a slot the fixtures never fill" (51 → 50) to "markup with none of the above" (34 → 35): it used to reach the DOM through `renderIcon`, which the audit reads as a slot; it now renders in JSX inside the span that carries the icon slot and the rotation. Still unfixtured either way; no prop gained or lost a fixture.

2026-10-17, G6 (the demo audit now reads Table): hand-edited, not re-recorded. `export default memo(Table)` resolves to a Property-flagged symbol, which audit-demo-coverage.mjs dropped, so this audit never saw Table either. propsWithoutFixture 639 → 705: HEAD measured 638 (the record had carried 639 since A2f, a field the check does not compare), plus Table’s 67 props with no fixture; no other prop moved. rendersMarkup 147 → 165, all 18 Table’s: a new role 0 → 3 (showHeader, floatingActions, children), a new interactive element 0 → 1 (renderColumnFilter), markup with none of the above 35 → 41 (emptyContent, caption, renderFilterIcon, renderExpandIcon, dragHandleIcon, searchIcon), the component itself 43 → 48 (onRowClick, floatingActionsHovered, popupOpen, expandOnRowClick, copyOnClick), a slot the fixtures never fill 50 → 53 (pinIcon, pinnedIcon, loadingMoreContent). The 147 other props are identical, prop for prop.

2026-10-19, S4 (hand-edited, not --record): rendersMarkup 165 -> 162, all three in "the component itself, present or absent" 48 -> 45: Input.onClear, TextArea.onClear and InternationalPhoneInput.onClear. Each replaced the clear with an early return when passed, so the field rendered differently with it than without; a clear now always clears and onClear only reports, so none of the three changes what renders. propsWithoutFixture 705 -> 691: HEAD measured 692 (the record had carried 705 since the Table row, a field the check does not compare), and TabPanel.disabled gained the `disabled` fixture. No other prop moved.

2026-10-31, A2d2 (hand-edited, not --record): rendersMarkup 162 -> 161, in "the component itself, present or absent" 45 -> 44: ResizablePanel.resizeDirection, now rendered by the `start` and `default-rtl` fixtures. propsWithoutFixture 691 -> 684: a clean 6eb6ccd5 measured 690 (the record carried 691, a field the check does not compare), and six props gained fixtures: ResizablePanel.resizeDirection, Button.iconAnimation and Button.animateIcon (`icon-slide-end`, `icon-slide-start`), Button.animateOnHover (`icon-slide-end-continuous`, `icon-slide-start-continuous`), Slider.min and Slider.max (`negative`). No prop joined the list.
